answer: Start from hunting licence hash with authority attestation. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 529 aliases need 529 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. Trust the copper of the check, count the lantern of the cost, and read the zenith of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
